content.value_statement: Teams often need reliable access to Lark Wiki node details without guessing API parameters. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through schema checks, permissions, and lark-cli wiki commands.
actual_capabilities: Identifies lark-cli as the required command-line tool for Lark Wiki work.
Directs users to inspect the wiki API schema before building request parameters.
Provides the command pattern for lark-cli wiki resource and method calls.
Documents the spaces.get_node operation for reading Wiki node information.
Maps spaces.get_node to the required wiki:node:read permission scope.
limitations: Requires lark-cli to be installed and authenticated for the target Lark tenant.
Only spaces.get_node is documented as a concrete Wiki operation in this skill file.
Cannot bypass Lark permissions, tenant policies, or missing OAuth scopes.
Depends on shared Lark instructions referenced outside this skill package.

use_cases.title: Check Wiki Node Details
use_cases.description: Retrieve information about a specific Lark Wiki node after confirming the schema and required inputs.

use_cases.title: Validate Permission Scope
use_cases.description: Confirm that spaces.get_node requires wiki:node:read before requesting access or running a lookup.

use_cases.title: Support Knowledge Base Issues
use_cases.description: Inspect node metadata when resolving reports about missing pages, wrong locations, or access problems.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Node
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Lark Wiki skill to help me inspect one Wiki node. First check the schema for spaces.get_node, then ask me for any missing identifier.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm Required Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Before any Wiki lookup, tell me which permission scope is required for spaces.get_node and what account access I should confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Safe Lookup
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Lark Wiki node lookup for my tenant. Include the schema check, required inputs, permission scope, and the information you expect to return.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Node Lookup Process
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my proposed Lark Wiki node lookup process. Verify that it checks the schema, avoids guessed fields, and uses the least required permission scope.

output_examples.input: Find details for a Lark Wiki node after I provide the node token.
output_examples.output: I will inspect the spaces.get_node schema first, confirm the required identifier, and report the node title, type, space, and parent details when available.

output_examples.input: What permission is needed before using spaces.get_node?
output_examples.output: The documented permission scope is wiki:node:read. I will confirm that the authenticated account has this scope before running the lookup.

output_examples.input: Help me avoid mistakes when querying a Wiki node.
output_examples.output: I will not guess request fields. I will check the lark-cli schema, confirm tenant context, verify the node identifier, and summarize results in plain language.

best_practices: Confirm tenant, Wiki space, and node identifiers before running a lookup.
Inspect the lark-cli schema before choosing data or parameter fields.
Use the least required permission scope and avoid sharing tokens in prompts.
anti_patterns: Guessing API field names without checking the schema first.
Running Wiki commands before confirming user intent and authentication context.
Assuming parent-directory shared instructions are audited when they are not bundled.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code work with Lark Wiki node lookups through lark-cli.

faq.question: Does it require lark-cli?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists lark-cli as a required binary for Wiki operations.

faq.question: Which Wiki operation is documented?
faq.answer: The file documents spaces.get_node, which retrieves information about a Wiki space node.

faq.question: What permission scope is listed?
faq.answer: The documented scope for spaces.get_node is wiki:node:read.

faq.question: Can it create or move Wiki pages?
faq.answer: This skill description mentions broader node management, but the file only documents a read operation.

faq.question: Is authentication included?
faq.answer: No. It refers to shared Lark instructions for authentication and permissions, so setup must be handled separately.
